visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a black leather-style pinafore dress, is positioned in front of a red brick wall. She waves her right hand toward the camera, her facial expression is bright and smiling, while sitting on a dark leather couch. (2) The creator presents a small gray box with Japanese and Chinese text, showcasing it to the camera with both hands. She then opens it to reveal a small figurine of the character Frieren stuck inside a Mimic treasure chest, which she holds up for a close-up. (3) She introduces cat-shaped clear capsule keychains, demonstrating how pet fur can be placed inside them. She shows different versions, including a white one and a grey one, holding them up individually with manicured hands while pointing out details. (4) A large LEGO product box titled 'Bouquet of Roses' is displayed, followed by the creator showing the interior bags of red LEGO bricks and a set of three instruction booklets. She gestures with surprise and excitement, her eyes widening as she speaks. (5) The creator continues speaking to the camera, with large orange and white text overlays appearing to announce a Shopee promotion. She uses various hand gestures, including a 'number one' sign and pointing downwards to emphasize the shopping event dates. (6) In the final segment, she holds both the Frieren figurine and a cat capsule together, explaining the giveaway rules to the audience. She waves goodbye with a smile as the video concludes, maintaining eye contact with the lens throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice introduces herself (Sandy) over a light, upbeat acoustic-pop background music track. The voice is energetic and high-arousal. There's a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect as graphics appear. (2) The speaker talks about unboxing items to give away. As she moves the gray box, a slight rustle of cardboard is heard. She describes the Frieren figurine. (3) A distinct 'click' sound is heard as she manipulates the cat capsule. She explains how to put pet hair inside. The background music continues steadily with a bright piano melody and soft percussion. (4) Loud rustling of plastic bags is heard as she opens the LEGO box. She expresses excitement with higher pitch and faster speech. (5) The speaker shifts to promoting a Shopee event on Nov 15-16. She emphasizes the '50% off' with a 'ding' sound effect and increased vocal intensity. (6) She summarizes the giveaway rules. The tone remains friendly and encouraging. The music swells slightly towards the end before fading out after a final "bye bye" and a transition SFX.
